in_sanskrit.name: थाल
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who holds the throne, the one who presides over the stage, the one who sits on a platform or seat, the one who is the master or controller of a situation or event.

in_hindi.name: थाला
in_hindi.meaning: थ्राँदना, स्थानीय, पत्थर, मूर्धानीय, थ्राने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: थ्राँदना: One who thrashes, beats, or punishes. स्थानीय: Belonging to a place. पत्थर: Stone. मूर्धानीय: Ruling, ruling over. थ्राने वाला: Controller, manager.

in_tamil.name: தல
in_tamil.meaning: Leader, Master, Stage, Throne, Platform, Seat
in_tamil.long_meaning: Leader: One who leads or guides. Master: One who has control or authority. Stage: A platform or raised area for performances or speeches. Throne: A seat of power or authority. Platform: A raised area for a specific purpose. Seat: A place to sit or rest.

in_marathi.name: Thala
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God, King, Leader
in_marathi.long_meaning: Thala हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Thala means 'God' or 'King' in Tamil language. It is a unisex name that represents power, strength, and courage. In Hinduism, Thala is also a name for Lord Murugan, the god of war and victory.
